about: Step 3B PR 7b-2 answer key (tests/delivery/expected/overview.json), written by the controller by hand before the code under R1, R2, R6, D7, D13 and rulings 7b-12 to 7b-17 (pr7b-rulings.md). Each row builds RunFacts from `facts` (its `modules` as ModuleFacts in order) and each document from `fixtures` + `file` after its replacements (each old once, in order), then calls build_run(facts, documents, wording). `expected`: a RunParts whose `id`, `head` and `overview` equal the given values whole (`at` a decimal string compared as Decimal) and whose modules' [id, state] pairs equal `module_states`. `left_out`: a LeftOut with the row's run_id whose rule equals the given text, or, when null, is a non-empty rule (a builder's refusal) holding no fixture text, source name or code. Every name is invented. Implementers do not edit this file.

bottomLine.label: Bottom line
bottomLine.lead: Creditors are exposed to refinancing risk rather than to weak earnings: net debt of USD 1,390 million is 4.2x earnings, and the next maturities fall inside two years.

findings.lead: Leverage is moderate but not low, at 4.2x net debt to EBITDA, so there is little room for an earnings miss.
A large part of the debt comes due soon: 38% of gross debt matures within 24 months, which makes refinancing access the deciding factor.
Liquidity support rests on an undrawn revolver that steps down, which narrows the cushion over time.

items.lead: Creditors are exposed to refinancing risk rather than to weak earnings: net debt of USD 1,390 million is 4.2x earnings, and the next maturities fall inside two years.

items.lead: the documents read give no monthly cash forecast and no revolver drawing terms, so cash cover of the maturities cannot be tested.

items.title: Business & governance
items.lead: Northbridge is a single-segment services group whose creditors depend on one operating company, so debt service rests on that company's cash generation.

items.text: The Covenant package was not reviewed,  so covenant headroom is not assessed
